title: A2UI Playground catalog
description: CopilotKit's Gen UI 2.0 standard components plus the playground's charts, maps, data views, inputs and domain cards, for dark chat surfaces.
instructions:
## Design rules

- Fully answer the request. Lead with a Heading, then the component built for the job: comparisons -> ComparisonTable, plans/options -> RadioGroup or ProductCard, schedules -> Agenda or Timeline, code -> CodeBlock, people -> ProfileCard or Avatar/AvatarGroup, statuses -> Badge, ratings -> Rating, a single ratio or score -> RadialProgress or Gauge, recipes -> RecipeCard, events -> EventCard, products -> ProductCard, flights -> FlightCard, weather -> WeatherCard. Pick the richest component that fits: charts for numbers over time or comparisons, MapView for places, DataTable for many rows, Timeline for sequences, domain cards when they match.
- Layout with Column, Row and Grid. Use Card only for an interactive panel (a form, controls) and Section to group with a title. Short text is Text, Title or Caption; prose is Markdown.
- Make the layout make sense: one chart per question unless the user asks for more, never two charts or a chart plus a table showing the same numbers, and never a chart whose series is flat or has under 3 points (use a Stat instead).
- Put KPIs in a Grid of Stat (add a Sparkline when a trend matters). Aim for 8 to 18 components, never more than 20: show each fact once (never the same list in both a map and a table), prefer one rich component over many small ones, but use small ones (Badge, Avatar, Divider) where they carry meaning.
- Concise copy, specific realistic data. If numbers are illustrative (no live source), end with a Caption saying "Illustrative data".
- Multi-series charts share one axis: only combine series of similar magnitude. Otherwise plot % change from a common start, or use one chart per series.
- Percent values are 0-100 (12.4 means 12.4%) with format "percent"; never fractions.
- Subtitles describe the content ("Revenue grew 12% on EMEA renewals"), never the UI itself.
- Maps: at most 8 markers, each a specific named place (landmark, venue, neighbourhood) that the plan text mentions, one per stop. Never use the city itself as a marker.
- Stat values are short numbers; put qualitative takeaways in KeyValueList, Callout or Markdown.
- Write final copy. Never say "placeholder", "sample text" or "lorem". Never use em dashes.

Card.description: A bordered, padded container, only for an interactive panel (controls, a form, a configurator). Tables, charts and text do not need one. Give it a Title and a Caption. Separate the groups in it with a Divider or the plain gap, never with a nested Card or a bordered Box. Variant "section" is a heading and content without a box. Variant "outline" always has a box. In markdown mode, a Card without controls renders as "section" unless it sets variant or border.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the image. It replaces the full-screen view.

Spacer.description: Flexible empty space. You almost never need it: use the default gap.

Divider.description: A line between two groups: horizontal, or vertical with axis "vertical" in a Row.

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Tabs.description: Tabs that show one panel at a time. Each tab has a title and the id of its panel component: "tabs":[{"title":"Specs","child":"specs"}].

child.description: The id of the panel component

selectedIndex.description: The open tab. Default 0. Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read it

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Title.description: A heading inside a Card or next to another component. A heading alone is markdown outside the fence. Use size "2xl" at most once in a surface, and "lg" for section headings. Size "sm" is an h4, "md" and "lg" are an h3 (default "md"), "xl" and larger are an h2. It is bold unless strong is false.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Text.description: Body text inside a Card or next to another component. A paragraph alone is markdown outside the fence. Use color "default" or "secondary". `text` can have inline markdown: **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, ++underline++, `code` and [link](https://example.com). The `children` ids render inline after the text, for example a Badge.

text.description: Text with inline markdown. A bound number shows as text

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

fontSize.description: Pixels when a number. Wins over size

minLines.description: Reserves the height of this many lines

Caption.description: Small secondary text: a hint under a control, or a label in a Row. `text` can have inline markdown.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Label.description: The label of a form field.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Badge.description: A small status pill. Use the colors success, danger and warning only to show a status, not for decoration.

Blockquote.description: A block quotation with a line on the left. `text` can have inline markdown.

text.description: The quoted text, with inline markdown

Code.description: A block of code in a monospace font.

Markdown.description: A block of GitHub-flavored markdown. Use it only next to other components, for example in a table cell or next to a chart. Markdown alone goes outside the fence.

Math.description: A TeX math formula, typeset with KaTeX. Set block to true for a centered formula on its own line.

ShimmerText.description: Text with a moving shimmer. It shows that something is loading or pending.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Link.description: A link. Only http, https and mailto URLs work. It opens in a new tab.

Tooltip.description: Shows `content` when the user points at `trigger` or moves keyboard focus to it. `trigger` is one child id: a Text, Icon or Badge, not a Button or Link. `content` is one child id of short text, for example a Text. Do not put links or buttons in `content`.

Button.description: A button that sends its onClick event. With href it opens the URL, and with copy it copies the text, both without the agent. Use variant "primary" for the one main Button in a Row, and the default for the others. With submit true inside a Form, it submits the Form. The child or children render instead of the label. With checks, it is disabled while a check fails.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the button.

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

text.description: Same as label. Used when label is not set

variant.description: Default "default": outlined. "primary" is filled, for the one main action. "borderless" has no box, like a link

submit.description: Submits the Form around it. The Form sends its onSubmit event

uniform.description: A square button, for an icon

href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab on click, instead of onClick

copy.description: Copies this text to the clipboard on click and shows a check mark, instead of onClick

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Pressable.description: A layout container that the user can click or press with Enter or Space. It sends its onClick event, or opens href. A control inside it sends only its own event.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks or presses the container.

href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab on click, instead of onClick

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

value.description: The chosen option values. Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to a string list

DateTimeInput.description: A date picker, or a time picker with enableTime, or both. Set timeStep (minutes) to offer fixed times, e.g. 30 for a booking. The value is ISO 8601. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read it. Give it a label.

label.description: The visible label of the field. Always set it

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

enableDate.description: The user picks a date. Default true unless only enableTime is set

timeStep.description: Minutes between the times the user can pick, e.g. 15 or 30. Shows the time as a list

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

PulseIndicator.description: A small dot that pulses, for example next to the text "Live". Set label when no text next to the dot says what it means.

label.description: What the dot means, for screen readers. Leave it unset when text next to the dot says the same

FlashcardFlip.description: A card that shows the front text. A click or the Enter key flips it to the back text, and again to the front.

hint.description: A small line under the front, for example "Click to flip"

Popover.description: A small overlay next to a trigger. Put exactly two children in it: one PopoverTrigger, then one PopoverContent. A click on the trigger opens and closes the content. Escape or a click outside closes it.

hoverOpenDelay.description: Milliseconds before a hover opens it. Default 0

PopoverTrigger.description: The trigger of a Popover. Its children are the label of the trigger: a Text or an Icon. Do not put a Button in it, because the trigger is already a button.

PopoverContent.description: The body of a Popover. It shows only when the Popover is open.

sideOffset.description: Pixels between the trigger and the content. Default 6

Modal.description: A dialog over the page. A click on the trigger (a Button or a Text) opens the content in the dialog. Escape, the close button or a click on the backdrop closes it.

open.description: Default false. Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read it

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Table.description: A data table. Put it in a plain Column, not in a Card. Give "columns" and "rows" (a list of row lists). Or give "children": TableSection or TableRow ids, or a template { "componentId", "path" } that repeats a TableRow for each item of a data list. To show a component (Badge, Button, Icon, Text) in a cell or a column header, set it to { "componentId": "<id>" } and put the id in "cellComponents".

rows.description: A list of row lists, or { "@path": "/x" }. A cell is a string, a number, or { "componentId": "<id>" } to show a component. Default []

caption.description: A short name of the table for screen readers. It is not shown

TableSection.description: A group of TableRow children in a Table. With header true, it is the header of the table.

header.description: Renders the rows as the header

TableRow.description: A row of a Table. Its children are TableCell ids, or a template. With label, a header cell with that text starts the row.

label.description: The text of a header cell at the start of the row

TableCell.description: A cell of a TableRow. It shows "text", or its children. With header true, it is a header cell.

List.description: A list in a Card or next to another component. A plain list of text is markdown, not a List. Give "items" (strings or { "label", "value"?, "description"?, "icon"? }); without an action, an item with a value is a key and value row, for facts like Price: $1,599. Or, when there are no items, give "children": ListItem ids or a template. With an "action", the user can pick an item: the event context gets "index", "label" and "value" of the item.

value.description: Without an action: shown on the right of the label, for a key and value fact. With an action: the payload of the pick, not shown

action.description: Runs when the user picks an item. The args are the index, label and value of the item.

maxMarkerSize.description: The width of the marker column in pixels

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

ListItem.description: An item of a List, with a label, a value on the right, a description, an icon and children. With an "action", the user can pick it.

value.description: Without an action: shown on the right of the label, for a key and value fact

action.description: Runs when the user picks the item.

marker.description: Shows this text as the marker

markerSize.description: The width of the marker column in pixels

disabled.description: Greys the item out and ignores its action

Chart.description: A bar, line, area, scatter, pie or donut chart. "data" is a list of objects. "xKey" is the field of the category. "series" are the value fields.

xKey.description: The field of the category axis

series.description: The value fields: strings or { "key", "label"?, "color"? }. Default: every number field except xKey

color.description: A text color token or a CSS color

layout.description: "horizontal" draws the bars from left to right. Default "vertical"

yAxis.description: The value axis configuration object: {label?: string, min?: number, max?: number, width?: number}. Example: {label: "Revenue (USD)", min: 0, max: 100}. In horizontal charts, label, min and max apply to the horizontal value axis, and width sets the width of the category axis on the left.

showDots.description: Point markers on a line or area

barRadius.description: The corner radius of a bar, in pixels

showLabelLines.description: Leader lines of the slice labels. Default true

format.description: Number formatting. With "percent", data values and axis min/max are fractions: 0.4 displays as 40%. For 0% to 10%, use min: 0 and max: 0.1.

Map.description: A map with markers. With "route", a line connects the markers in order. Bind "selected" to { "@path": "/x" } to get the label of the marker that the user picks. When maps are not available, it shows a list of the places.

selected.description: The label of the selected marker. Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read the choice of the user

route.description: Draws a line through the markers in order

zoom.description: With two or more markers, only the highest zoom of the fit

Image.description: An image from a URL. A click opens it full-screen. Set description to say what the image shows, unless it is only decoration.

description.description: What the image shows, for screen readers. Leave it unset only for a decorative image

onOverlayClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the actionOverlay button and it has no href.

variant.description: The size: "icon" 24px, "avatar" 40px round, "smallFeature" 160px wide, "largeFeature" and "header" full width. Default "mediumFeature": the natural size

fallback.description: Text shown in place of the image when it does not load

lightbox.description: Default true: a click opens the image full-screen

actionOverlay.description: A button over the bottom-right corner of the image. Without href, it sends onOverlayClick

href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Icon.description: A Lucide icon by kebab-case name (for example "arrow-right"), or an A2UI icon name (for example "arrowBack"). Set label when no text next to the icon says what it means.

name.description: A Lucide icon name in kebab-case ("arrow-right"), an A2UI icon name ("arrowBack"), or { "svgPath" } on a 24px grid

label.description: What the icon means, for screen readers. Leave it unset when text next to the icon says the same

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Favicon.description: The favicon of the site at a URL.

Svg.description: A vector drawing from primitive shapes (paths, circles, rects, lines, texts). Colors take text color tokens or CSS colors.

label.description: What the drawing shows, for screen readers. Leave it unset for a decorative drawing

Video.description: A video player for a video file URL (with optional captions), or a YouTube link in privacy-enhanced mode: the poster shows first, and the player loads when the user presses play. A page on another video site shows as a link to it. Set title to name the video.

url.description: The URL of a video file, or of a YouTube video or short. A page on another video site shows as a link

title.description: Names the video for screen readers

captions.description: Caption tracks of a video file

url.description: The URL of a WebVTT file

posterUrl.description: The image shown before the video plays

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

AudioPlayer.description: An audio player for an audio file URL, with the description above it.

url.description: The URL of the audio file

description.description: A title or summary of the audio, shown above the player

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

HtmlView.description: Raw HTML in a fully sandboxed iframe: no scripts, no same-origin access. Set title to name the content.

LinkCard.description: A preview card of a URL: the favicon and domain, the title, a description and a thumbnail. A click opens the link in a new tab, or sends onClick when it is bound. Use it for sources, articles and products that have a page.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the card, instead of the link.

domain.description: Shown next to the favicon. Default: the host of href

Citation.description: An inline source marker ([1]) that shows the source on hover or click: the title, a snippet and a link. Put it inline after the sentence it supports, as a child of a Text or in a Row.

label.description: Marker text instead of the number, for example a domain

snippet.description: The quoted passage, one or two lines

source.description: The publisher or domain. Default: the host of url

FollowUp.description: Suggested next prompts as pills. A click sends the message of the pill as the next turn of the user, with no event binding needed. Put it at the end of a surface, with two to four short items.

message.description: The text sent when the user clicks. Default: label

onFollowUp.description: Sent when the user clicks a pill. The args carry the message of the pill.

EntityCard.description: A card for one thing (a product, place, person or listing): an image, title, subtitle, description, a price or meta line, a badge, a rating and up to three buttons. href opens a page, and onClick is sent when it is bound. Use a Grid of EntityCards for several things.

actions.description: Up to three buttons. A button without href sends onAction with its label

href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab

onAction.description: Sent when the user clicks a button without href. The args carry the label of the button.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the card and it has no href.

subtitle.description: A second line, for example the brand or category

meta.description: A short fact line, for example "$29 / month" or "Open until 22:00"

href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab when the user clicks the card

layout.description: Default "vertical". "horizontal" puts the image on the left

ImageGrid.description: A gallery of images in a grid. A click opens the image full-screen, with arrows to the other images. layout "bento" makes the first image twice as large.

href.description: Opens this URL instead of the full-screen view

layout.description: Default "grid". "bento" makes the first image twice as large

Section.description: Titled group with eyebrow, title, description, and children.

Accordion.description: Collapsible items (FAQs, details, per-file notes); each has a title and either text or a child id.

Heading.description: Surface title with optional eyebrow and subtitle. Start most surfaces with one.

CodeBlock.description: Syntax-colored code with language label and copy button. Use for any code, config, command or diff snippet.

Quote.description: Pull quote with attribution: testimonial, review, reviewer comment.

Kbd.description: Keyboard shortcut chips, e.g. keys ['Cmd','K'] with a label. Use for shortcuts and how-to steps.

Stat.description: One numeric KPI: label, short value (number or <10 chars like '$84k'), optional delta (e.g. '+4.2%'), caption. Not for sentences.

StatGroup.description: Compact strip of several KPIs in one card.

Avatar.description: Person avatar (initials if no image) with name and subtitle: authors, owners, reviewers.

AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping avatar stack with +N overflow: attendees, team members, reviewers.

DataTable.description: Sortable, filterable table (TanStack Table). columns [{key,label,format?}], rows are objects keyed by column key.

KeyValueList.description: Label/value rows, e.g. specs or order details.

Timeline.description: Vertical timeline of dated events or steps with status.

Progress.description: Labelled progress bar, value 0-100: goals, budgets used, completion, coverage.

RadialProgress.description: Ring with centered value, value 0-100: a single score or percent complete.

Rating.description: Star rating (0-5) with optional review count: products, places, reviews.

Agenda.description: Calendar agenda: days with timed events (conference, week plan, schedule). Prefer over Timeline for clock times.

ComparisonTable.description: Feature matrix comparing options side by side; values may be true/false/text; highlight marks the recommended option.

LineChart.description: Trend over ordered x. data [{x,y,series?}]; one line per series.

AreaChart.description: Filled trend for volumes or cumulative totals (traffic, signups); series stack. data [{x,y,series?}].

BarChart.description: Compare categories. data [{x,y,series?}]; series grouped side by side, or stacked:true. horizontal for long labels.

PieChart.description: Part-to-whole. data [{label,value}]; donut:true for a ring with center total.

ScatterChart.description: Relationship between two numbers (price vs rating, effort vs impact). data [{x,y,label?,size?,series?}].

Heatmap.description: Matrix of values, e.g. day x hour. data [{x,y,value}] with x,y categories.

Sparkline.description: Tiny trend with label and latest value; a compact KPI with history, fits in a Grid instead of Stat. values: numbers.

RadarChart.description: Multi-axis profile (scores per criterion for 2-3 options or people). data [{axis,value,series?}], values on a shared scale.

SankeyChart.description: Flows between stages, e.g. budget or funnel paths. links [{source,target,value}].

Gauge.description: Half-ring gauge for a single value within min..max (score, utilization).

MapView.description: Interactive dark map (MapLibre) with numbered markers; fits all markers. markers [{name,lat,lon,description?}].

RouteMap.description: Map with a route line through coordinates [[lon,lat],...] plus start/end pins and distance/duration.

LocationCard.description: Single place (venue, hotel, office): mini map, name, address, category, rating, actions. Use instead of MapView for one place.

PlaceList.description: Split view: ranked list of places linked to a map; hovering/clicking a row highlights its marker. selected (row index) starts with that row highlighted.

Combobox.description: Searchable dropdown for long option lists (countries, cities, timezones).

Switch.description: On/off toggle with label and description.

DatePicker.description: Date picker with calendar popover; value ISO date bound to a path.

ButtonGroup.description: Segmented single-choice control; value bound to a path.

ChipSelect.description: Multi-select chips bound to a string-list path: extras, interests, dietary needs.

Alert.description: Inline alert with icon, title and message.

Callout.description: Highlighted tip or note with optional emoji/icon and a call to action.

onAction.description: Fires when the call-to-action button is clicked.

EmptyState.description: Empty or zero-results state with icon, title, hint and optional action: no matches, nothing scheduled, inbox zero.

onAction.description: Fires when the action button is clicked.

WeatherCard.description: Current weather hero with condition icon, temp, high/low, details, an hourly strip and daily forecast. icon: sun|cloud-sun|cloud|fog|drizzle|rain|snow|storm.

ProfileCard.description: Person card: avatar, name, role, company, location, bio, contacts, tags, stats. Use for team members, speakers, candidates.

ReceiptCard.description: Order receipt: merchant, order id, date, line items with qty and price, subtotal/tax/total, status.

EventCard.description: Event: date block, title, time, venue, host, attendees count, tags, RSVP action. Lead an event or conference with it.

onAction.description: Fires when the RSVP button is clicked.

StockTicker.description: Stock quote header: symbol, name, price, change and % change, sparkline, key stats. sample:true labels illustrative data.

RecipeCard.description: Recipe: title, time/servings/difficulty, ingredient checklist and numbered steps. Use for any recipe or cooking how-to.

required.description: Valid when the value is not empty

regex.description: Valid when the value matches the pattern

length.description: Valid when the length of the value is within min and max

numeric.description: Valid when the value is a number within min and max

email.description: Valid when the value is an email address

formatString.description: Interpolates ${/path}, ${relative/path} and ${fn(arg: value)} in the value; \${ is a literal

formatNumber.description: The number in the locale of the user

formatCurrency.description: The amount as money, with an ISO 4217 currency code

formatDate.description: A date or ISO string in a TR35 pattern, for example "MMM d, yyyy" or "HH:mm"

pluralize.description: The string of the plural category of the value

openUrl.description: Opens an http(s) URL in a new tab. Only from an event

and.description: True when every value is true

or.description: True when any value is true

calc.description: The value of an arithmetic expression over the other args, by name: + - * / % ( ), comparisons, && || !, cond ? a : b, min max round floor ceil abs, 'text' + name

series.description: A list of count copies of item, for chart data and template lists. Put arithmetic in ${expression} strings in item, using the loop variable (default i, counting from start, default 1) and other named args. A whole-expression string retains the result type, so "${i * monthlyCost}" yields a number. Arguments, including nested calc or formatString calls in item, resolve before the series loop; those calls cannot use the loop variable. Example: {"@call":"series","args":{"count":6,"item":{"month":"${i}","cost":"${i * monthlyCost}"},"monthlyCost":{"@path":"/monthlyCost"}}}. Omit variable to use i.
